_howto: Name the file MB-OC-<siman>-<skFrom>-<skTo>-<Topic-In-Hyphens>.mp3 with three digits for each number, then add the path here as one line. Everything shown on the page comes from the filename. To cross into the next siman: MB-OC-429-014-to-430-003-Topic.mp3. If you want a topic with apostrophes or punctuation, use the object form instead: { "file": "audio/....mp3", "topic": "Ma'os chittim" } - that overrides the filename.
